title: Discrete intermediate dimensions: endpoints, spectra and quasi-isometric invariance
summary: We introduce upper and lower discrete intermediate dimensions for unbounded subsets of Euclidean space and extend them to metric spaces. The definitions restrict the covering radii within a scale-dependent range of dyadic shells and take a supremum over an auxiliary parameter. The resulting dimensions are monotone in the parameter and recover the Barlow--Taylor discrete Hausdorff dimension at zero. We prove continuity at every positive parameter, with a sharp quantitative bound, and give an example with a jump at zero. At the upper endpoint, the upper dimension equals upper mass dimension…
